factions.name: Space Pirates
factions.description: Loose confederation of raiders and freebooters. Your people — mostly.

factions.name: Merchant Guild
factions.description: Wealthy traders who control commerce lanes. Rob them, pay the price.

factions.name: Military
factions.description: The law. Well-armed, well-funded, and very unhappy with you.

factions.name: Scavengers
factions.description: Scrap merchants and opportunists. They'll deal with anyone.
Something older than the nations. It has been watching.
factions.lore: The Void Collective knows of them. The Technocracy denies their existence. Three captains who found their signal were never heard from again.

nations.name: Terran Compact
nations.description: Human government and military hub. Law-abiding, heavily armed.
nations.nation_upgrade: Compact Alliance — military ships cost 15% less

nations.name: Merchant Syndicate
nations.description: Trade guilds and commerce barons. Money talks louder than guns here.
nations.nation_upgrade: Syndicate Rates — sell prices +20% in all markets

nations.name: Free Colonies
nations.description: Independent settlers. Scrappy, resourceful, and suspicious of outsiders.
nations.nation_upgrade: Colony Network — patrol ships find 25% more resources

nations.name: The Technocracy
nations.description: Advanced science and AI state. Drones, robots, cutting-edge tech.
nations.nation_upgrade: Tech Integration — research lab upgrades 20% cheaper

nations.name: Void Collective
nations.description: Mysterious, almost alien faction from the deep sectors. Ancient. Unknowable.
nations.nation_upgrade: Void Attunement — secret item drop rate doubled
